mapper.select: SELECT i.*, t.prompt, t.name_zh AS nameZh, t.category FROM workspace_item i LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = i.ref_id AND i.item_type = 'tag' WHERE i.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.id
SELECT i.*, t.prompt, t.name_zh AS nameZh, t.category FROM workspace_item i LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = i.ref_id AND i.item_type = 'tag' WHERE i.id = #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) FROM workspace_item WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_item (workspace_id, item_type, ref_id, polarity, weight, section_override, sort_order) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{itemType}, #{refId}, #{polarity}, #{weight}, #{sectionOverride}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_item SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
